#チェンソーマン マキマ 🪢

公安対魔特異4課を率いる謎めいた女性「マキマ」。デンジとの出会いをきっかけに彼を導きながら、物語の裏で暗躍し、チェンソーマンを象徴する存在として強い印象を残す人気キャラクターです。

This meme perfectly captures that one moment when your friend suddenly notices someone on your phone and immediately turns into a full-time investigator. 😂📱 The innocent-looking question, “Bhaiya, aapke phone mein wo didi kaun hai?” sounds simple, but everyone knows there’s definitely a follow-up interrogation coming.

The joke comes from the curiosity of younger siblings or friends who notice something on your phone and instantly want the complete backstory. 😭😂 One random picture or contact is enough to start a conversation that you were definitely not prepared for.

Basically, you thought you were casually using your phone… and suddenly you’re being questioned like you’re hiding a national secret. 💀📱
